scope: Four Equipment boards on 02 Approved; reviewed exports Review/Equipment-{Loadout,Wooden-Shield,Crimson-Flask,Empty-Chest}.png and Review/Equipment-Empty-Icons.png. Main board: 8b1ed794-e91e-807d-8008-a328d714c22e.
styleProfile: Editorial, adapted to the existing restrained dark fantasy inventory design
skeleton: Equipment grid / lore detail / character status rail

axes.evidence: Equipment heading leads the screen. Gold 2px outline identifies one selected slot; occupied art and E badges separate equipped items from 45% opacity category ghosts.
1920x1080 frame retains the approved atmosphere, header and footer. 584px equipment panel, 648px lore panel and 464px status rail align with two 48px gaps.
Approved Cinzel headings, EB Garamond body and Inter utility text remain legible without clipping. Category row labels were removed at user request; small ammo labels remain 14px.
Warm ivory text, charcoal olive surfaces, restrained gold selection and desaturated empty ghosts preserve the existing inventory palette. Only equipped item art is saturated.

28 cells use 88px bodies, 64px independent images, 12px gaps, and seven explicit flex rows; all created boards have flex layouts. Arms canvas padding normalizes its optical height with the other armor icons.

Slot counts match EquipmentSlotCatalog and EquipmentUi.prefab. Three occupied item descriptions/lore map to ItemDatabase.asset. An empty chest state explains the next action; Character Status deliberately retains existing sample values.

The reference-inspired slot arrangement uses the project's existing smoke atmosphere, serif typography, equipped art and selection treatment. Ten category-specific empty silhouettes replace generic placeholders.

findings.issue: Penpot's fontFamilies token binding rejected the API call; some cloned/new shapes expose incomplete token metadata even though their rendered values match the existing semantic palette and font styles.
findings.fix: Preserve the current appearance. Rebind the existing semantic font-family and color tokens when the Penpot token API supports reliable binding; do not create duplicate raw-value tokens.

assumptions: Desktop design at the existing 1920x1080 logical canvas; no smaller-screen variant requested.
Left-hand ghosts use shield art and right-hand ghosts use weapon art as visual category cues; they do not change runtime slot compatibility.
All ten quick-item slots use the requested flask ghost as a generic empty quick-item cue.
Character stats and equipped quantity 5 are inherited/illustrative design content, not a captured live game state.
Only RightHand1, LeftHand1, QuickItem1 and Chest navigate between the four preview states; action-key hints are visual and do not perform equipment mutations.
Visual and structural review only; no full WCAG audit, game integration or Unity validation performed.
